## Public interface and compatibility boundary

missing downstream predicate + authority -> verified SATISFIED / exact INCOMPLETE; never product implementation. Concrete values and return targets belong to the owning step's configured instance. Private changes do not alter public semantics; update actual consumers for a real contract change.

## Rules, process, recipe actions, and allowed variations

P01–P15 own shared rules. Semantic choices in recipe verbs remain ROOT decisions; test_root only authors declared lane-local contracts. Workers mechanically execute supplied choices and return any missing meaning. Reviewer findings remain open within assigned boundaries. Each governing card cites all actions; member cards cite only their ordered subset. Parameters may select bounded source/test paths and optional profiles, never weaken acceptance or change authority.

| Order | Recipe action ID | Project-specific action/process | Allowed parameterization | Decision owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | M01-A1 | Re-read the named downstream precondition and its authority source. | owning instance exact paths, proof goals, predecessor output and selected scope | root |
| 2 | M01-A2 | Observe current state without mutation and record `SATISFIED`, `MISSING`, or `INDETERMINATE`. | owning instance exact paths, proof goals, predecessor output and selected scope | root |
| 3 | M01-A3 | If satisfied, publish the observation and stop; do not perform setup again. | owning instance exact paths, proof goals, predecessor output and selected scope | root |
| 4 | M01-A4 | If missing and authorized, perform only the named prerequisite action. | owning instance exact paths, proof goals, predecessor output and selected scope | root |
| 5 | M01-A5 | Read back or otherwise independently verify the resulting state. | owning instance exact paths, proof goals, predecessor output and selected scope | root |
| 6 | M01-A6 | Publish the prerequisite result; persist a record only when a downstream consumer needs it. | owning instance exact paths, proof goals, predecessor output and selected scope | root |
| 7 | M01-A7 | If indeterminate or unauthorized, publish `INCOMPLETE` and the exact unresolved fact/owner. | owning instance exact paths, proof goals, predecessor output and selected scope | root |

- `SATISFIED` unlocks only consumers that declare this result as an input.
- Failed prerequisite setup returns to the same M01 owner only when the failure is correctable within
  the original card; otherwise it is `INCOMPLETE`.
- Discovery of product work exits to plan amendment; M01 cannot absorb it.
